feedback: This candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The controller reduces base_speed slightly to 1.35 to further improve stability and reduce aggressive driving. The kd gain is increased to 4.0 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations, while kp remains at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain responsiveness and integral correction. Sensor weights are set to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0], preserving steering balance and increasing inner sensor influence for better precision. The geometry remains unchanged, which is reasonable given no reported issues. I recommend approving this candidate to race and obtain telemetry data on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify if these changes improve stability and line tracking as expected. No further changes are requested before racing.
